dialogue.text: In a small, peaceful village nestled between rolling hills, there was a school called Brightwood Academy.
dialogue.zh: 在一個坐落於起伏山丘之間的小而寧靜的村莊裡，有一所名為布萊特伍德學院的學校。
dialogue.ja: 緩やかな丘に囲まれた小さくて平和な村に、ブライトウッドアカデミーという学校がありました。
dialogue.local: In a small, peaceful village nestled between rolling hills, there was a school called Brightwood Academy.
dialogue.en: In a small, peaceful village nestled between rolling hills, there was a school called Brightwood Academy.

dialogue.text: The school was known for its brilliant teachers who loved their students and worked tirelessly to help them learn and grow.
dialogue.zh: 這所學校以其出色的老師聞名，他們熱愛學生，孜孜不倦地幫助學生學習和成長。
dialogue.ja: その学校は、生徒を愛し、学びと成長を助けるために懸命に働く優秀な教師たちで知られていました。
dialogue.local: The school was known for its brilliant teachers who loved their students and worked tirelessly to help them learn and grow.
dialogue.en: The school was known for its brilliant teachers who loved their students and worked tirelessly to help them learn and grow.

dialogue.text: Among these teachers was Mrs. Eliza, kind and patient woman who had been teaching for over 30 years.
dialogue.zh: 在這些老師中，有一位名叫伊莉莎夫人的善良且有耐心的女士，她教書已超過三十年。
dialogue.ja: その教師たちの中に、30年以上教えている親切で忍耐強いエリザ先生がいました。
dialogue.local: Among these teachers was Mrs. Eliza, kind and patient woman who had been teaching for over 30 years.
dialogue.en: Among these teachers was Mrs. Eliza, kind and patient woman who had been teaching for over 30 years.

dialogue.text: Her classroom was always full of laughter, creativity, and knowledge.
dialogue.zh: 她的教室總是充滿歡笑、創意和知識。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の教室はいつも笑い声と創造性、そして知識で溢れていました。
dialogue.local: Her classroom was always full of laughter, creativity, and knowledge.
dialogue.en: Her classroom was always full of laughter, creativity, and knowledge.

dialogue.text: But recently, something strange had started happening in Mrs. Eliza's classroom.
dialogue.zh: 但最近，伊莉莎夫人的教室裡開始發生一些奇怪的事情。
dialogue.ja: しかし最近、エリザ先生の教室で奇妙なことが起こり始めました。
dialogue.local: But recently, something strange had started happening in Mrs. Eliza's classroom.
dialogue.en: But recently, something strange had started happening in Mrs. Eliza's classroom.

dialogue.text: The students, who once adored her, had begun to ignore her lessons.
dialogue.zh: 那些曾經崇拜她的學生，開始忽視她的課程。
dialogue.ja: かつて彼女を慕っていた生徒たちが、授業を無視し始めたのです。
dialogue.local: The students, who once adored her, had begun to ignore her lessons.
dialogue.en: The students, who once adored her, had begun to ignore her lessons.

dialogue.text: It all began with a group of children who thought they knew everything.
dialogue.zh: 這一切都始於一群自以為無所不知的孩子。
dialogue.ja: それは、何でも知っていると思い込んでいる子どもたちのグループから始まりました。
dialogue.local: It all began with a group of children who thought they knew everything.
dialogue.en: It all began with a group of children who thought they knew everything.

dialogue.text: At the center of this group were two students. Max and Clara.
dialogue.zh: 這群孩子的中心是兩名學生，麥克斯和克拉拉。
dialogue.ja: そのグループの中心には、マックスとクララという二人の生徒がいました。
dialogue.local: At the center of this group were two students. Max and Clara.
dialogue.en: At the center of this group were two students. Max and Clara.

dialogue.text: Max was a bright boy but had become overconfident and disrespectful.
dialogue.zh: 麥克斯是一個聰明的男孩，但變得過於自信且不尊重人。
dialogue.ja: マックスは賢い少年でしたが、自信過剰で礼儀を欠くようになっていました。
dialogue.local: Max was a bright boy but had become overconfident and disrespectful.
dialogue.en: Max was a bright boy but had become overconfident and disrespectful.

dialogue.text: He often interrupted Mrs. Eliza during lessons and joked with his friends instead of paying attention.
dialogue.zh: 他經常在課堂上打斷伊莉莎夫人，和朋友開玩笑而不專心聽講。
dialogue.ja: 彼は授業中にエリザ先生の話を遮り、注意を払わずに友達と冗談を言っていました。
dialogue.local: He often interrupted Mrs. Eliza during lessons and joked with his friends instead of paying attention.
dialogue.en: He often interrupted Mrs. Eliza during lessons and joked with his friends instead of paying attention.

dialogue.text: Clara, who was equally smart, would roll her eyes at Mrs. Eliza's instructions and whispered to her friends, mocking the teacher's old-fashioned ways.
dialogue.zh: 同樣聰明的克拉拉會對伊莉莎夫人的指示翻白眼，並低聲對朋友嘲笑老師過時的教學方式。
dialogue.ja: 同じく賢いクララは、エリザ先生の指示に目をむき、友達にこっそりと先生の古臭いやり方を嘲笑っていました。
dialogue.local: Clara, who was equally smart, would roll her eyes at Mrs. Eliza's instructions and whispered to her friends, mocking the teacher's old-fashioned ways.
dialogue.en: Clara, who was equally smart, would roll her eyes at Mrs. Eliza's instructions and whispered to her friends, mocking the teacher's old-fashioned ways.

dialogue.text: Other students, seeing Max and Clara's behavior, began to join in.
dialogue.zh: 其他學生看到麥克斯和克拉拉的行為，也開始跟著模仿。
dialogue.ja: マックスとクララの行動を見た他の生徒たちも、それに加わり始めました。
dialogue.local: Other students, seeing Max and Clara's behavior, began to join in.
dialogue.en: Other students, seeing Max and Clara's behavior, began to join in.

dialogue.text: They whispered during lessons, giggled at Mrs. Eliza's mistakes, and sometimes even ignored her completely.
dialogue.zh: 他們在課堂上竊竊私語，對伊莉莎夫人的錯誤竊笑，有時甚至完全忽視她。
dialogue.ja: 授業中にささやき、エリザ先生のミスを笑い、時には完全に無視することもありました。
dialogue.local: They whispered during lessons, giggled at Mrs. Eliza's mistakes, and sometimes even ignored her completely.
dialogue.en: They whispered during lessons, giggled at Mrs. Eliza's mistakes, and sometimes even ignored her completely.

dialogue.text: The once lively classroom now felt cold and chaotic.
dialogue.zh: 曾經熱鬧的教室現在感覺冷清且混亂。
dialogue.ja: かつて活気に満ちていた教室は、今や冷たく混沌とした場所になっていました。
dialogue.local: The once lively classroom now felt cold and chaotic.
dialogue.en: The once lively classroom now felt cold and chaotic.

dialogue.text: Mrs. Eliza, though hurt, continued to teach with all her heart, hoping her students would realize their mistakes.
dialogue.zh: 伊莉莎夫人雖然受傷，但仍全心全意教學，希望學生們能意識到自己的錯誤。
dialogue.ja: エリザ先生は傷つきながらも、心を込めて教え続け、生徒たちが自分の過ちに気づくことを願っていました。
dialogue.local: Mrs. Eliza, though hurt, continued to teach with all her heart, hoping her students would realize their mistakes.
dialogue.en: Mrs. Eliza, though hurt, continued to teach with all her heart, hoping her students would realize their mistakes.

dialogue.text: One day, Mrs. Eliza decided to teach her students a different kind of lesson.
dialogue.zh: 有一天，伊莉莎夫人決定教學生一堂不同的課。
dialogue.ja: ある日、エリザ先生は生徒たちにいつもとは違う授業をすることにしました。
dialogue.local: One day, Mrs. Eliza decided to teach her students a different kind of lesson.
dialogue.en: One day, Mrs. Eliza decided to teach her students a different kind of lesson.

dialogue.text: She brought a jar filled with small seeds to class.
dialogue.zh: 她帶來一罐裝滿小種子的罐子到教室。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は小さな種が入った瓶を教室に持ってきました。
dialogue.local: She brought a jar filled with small seeds to class.
dialogue.en: She brought a jar filled with small seeds to class.

dialogue.text: Today, she said, we are going to plant these seeds and watch them grow.
dialogue.zh: 她說，今天我們要種下這些種子，並觀察它們成長。
dialogue.ja: 「今日は、この種を植えて育てる授業をします」と彼女は言いました。
dialogue.local: Today, she said, we are going to plant these seeds and watch them grow.
dialogue.en: Today, she said, we are going to plant these seeds and watch them grow.

dialogue.text: Each of you will take care of your own plant.
dialogue.zh: 你們每個人都要照顧自己的植物。
dialogue.ja: それぞれが自分の植物を世話します。
dialogue.local: Each of you will take care of your own plant.
dialogue.en: Each of you will take care of your own plant.

dialogue.text: The students, curious about the activity, eagerly planted their seeds in small pots.
dialogue.zh: 學生們對這個活動感到好奇，興奮地將種子種在小盆栽裡。
dialogue.ja: 生徒たちは興味津々で、小さな鉢に種を植えました。
dialogue.local: The students, curious about the activity, eagerly planted their seeds in small pots.
dialogue.en: The students, curious about the activity, eagerly planted their seeds in small pots.

dialogue.text: Mrs. Eliza instructed them on how to water and care for the seeds.
dialogue.zh: 伊莉莎夫人指導他們如何澆水和照顧種子。
dialogue.ja: エリザ先生は種の水やりや世話の仕方を教えました。
dialogue.local: Mrs. Eliza instructed them on how to water and care for the seeds.
dialogue.en: Mrs. Eliza instructed them on how to water and care for the seeds.

dialogue.text: If you follow my instructions carefully, she explained, you will see your plants grow strong and beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 她解釋說，如果你們仔細遵循我的指示，就會看到植物茁壯美麗地成長。
dialogue.ja: 「私の指示をよく守れば、強く美しい植物が育ちます」と彼女は説明しました。
dialogue.local: If you follow my instructions carefully, she explained, you will see your plants grow strong and beautiful.
dialogue.en: If you follow my instructions carefully, she explained, you will see your plants grow strong and beautiful.

dialogue.text: But Max and Clara laughed at the idea, how hard can it be to grow a plant?
dialogue.zh: 但麥克斯和克拉拉嘲笑這個想法，種植物有多難？
dialogue.ja: しかしマックスとクララはその考えを笑い、「植物を育てるのがそんなに難しいの？」と言いました。
dialogue.local: But Max and Clara laughed at the idea, how hard can it be to grow a plant?
dialogue.en: But Max and Clara laughed at the idea, how hard can it be to grow a plant?

dialogue.text: Max said dismissively, Clara smirked, it's just dirt and water, she said.
dialogue.zh: 麥克斯輕蔑地說，克拉拉得意地笑著說，這不過是泥土和水而已。
dialogue.ja: マックスは軽蔑して言い、クララはにやりと笑い、「ただの土と水よ」と言いました。
dialogue.local: Max said dismissively, Clara smirked, it's just dirt and water, she said.
dialogue.en: Max said dismissively, Clara smirked, it's just dirt and water, she said.

dialogue.text: We don't need her silly instructions.
dialogue.zh: 我們不需要她那些愚蠢的指示。
dialogue.ja: 「彼女のくだらない指示なんて必要ない」と言いました。
dialogue.local: We don't need her silly instructions.
dialogue.en: We don't need her silly instructions.

dialogue.text: Over the next few weeks, most of the students followed Mrs. Eliza's guidance.
dialogue.zh: 接下來的幾週，大多數學生都遵循伊莉莎夫人的指導。
dialogue.ja: その後数週間、ほとんどの生徒はエリザ先生の指導に従いました。
dialogue.local: Over the next few weeks, most of the students followed Mrs. Eliza's guidance.
dialogue.en: Over the next few weeks, most of the students followed Mrs. Eliza's guidance.

dialogue.text: They watered their plants daily, placed them in the sunlight, and even talked to them as Mrs. Eliza had suggested.
dialogue.zh: 他們每天澆水，將植物放在陽光下，甚至像伊莉莎夫人建議的那樣和植物說話。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは毎日水をやり、日光に当て、エリザ先生の提案通りに植物に話しかけました。
dialogue.local: They watered their plants daily, placed them in the sunlight, and even talked to them as Mrs. Eliza had suggested.
dialogue.en: They watered their plants daily, placed them in the sunlight, and even talked to them as Mrs. Eliza had suggested.

dialogue.text: But Max and Clara ignored her advice.
dialogue.zh: 但麥克斯和克拉拉忽視了她的建議。
dialogue.ja: しかしマックスとクララは彼女の助言を無視しました。
dialogue.local: But Max and Clara ignored her advice.
dialogue.en: But Max and Clara ignored her advice.

dialogue.text: Max over watered his plant, drowning it, while Clara left hers in a dark corner, forgetting to water it for days.
dialogue.zh: 麥克斯澆水過多，淹死了植物，而克拉拉則把植物放在陰暗角落，幾天沒澆水。
dialogue.ja: マックスは水をやりすぎて植物を溺れさせ、クララは暗い隅に置き、何日も水をやるのを忘れていました。
dialogue.local: Max over watered his plant, drowning it, while Clara left hers in a dark corner, forgetting to water it for days.
dialogue.en: Max over watered his plant, drowning it, while Clara left hers in a dark corner, forgetting to water it for days.

dialogue.text: When the day came to show their plants, the classroom was filled with beautiful green sprouts and flowers, except for Max and Clara's.
dialogue.zh: 展示植物的那天，教室裡充滿了美麗的綠芽和花朵，唯獨麥克斯和克拉拉的植物例外。
dialogue.ja: 植物を見せる日、教室は美しい緑の芽や花でいっぱいでしたが、マックスとクララのものは違いました。
dialogue.local: When the day came to show their plants, the classroom was filled with beautiful green sprouts and flowers, except for Max and Clara's.
dialogue.en: When the day came to show their plants, the classroom was filled with beautiful green sprouts and flowers, except for Max and Clara's.

dialogue.text: Max's plant was wilted and brown, while Clara's seed had not sprouted at all.
dialogue.zh: 麥克斯的植物枯萎變褐，克拉拉的種子根本沒有發芽。
dialogue.ja: マックスの植物はしおれて茶色くなり、クララの種は全く芽が出ていませんでした。
dialogue.local: Max's plant was wilted and brown, while Clara's seed had not sprouted at all.
dialogue.en: Max's plant was wilted and brown, while Clara's seed had not sprouted at all.

dialogue.text: They looked at their classmates' healthy plants in embarrassment.
dialogue.zh: 他們尷尬地看著同學們健康的植物。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは恥ずかしそうにクラスメートの元気な植物を見ました。
dialogue.local: They looked at their classmates' healthy plants in embarrassment.
dialogue.en: They looked at their classmates' healthy plants in embarrassment.

dialogue.text: Mrs. Eliza walked over to their pots and gently said,
dialogue.zh: 伊莉莎夫人走到他們的盆栽旁，溫柔地說：
dialogue.ja: エリザ先生は彼らの鉢に近づき、優しく言いました。
dialogue.local: Mrs. Eliza walked over to their pots and gently said,
dialogue.en: Mrs. Eliza walked over to their pots and gently said,

dialogue.text: Do you see what happens when you don't listen and respect the guidance you were given?
dialogue.zh: 你們看到不聽從和不尊重指導會發生什麼事了嗎？
dialogue.ja: 「与えられた指導を聞かず尊重しないとどうなるか、わかりますか？」
dialogue.local: Do you see what happens when you don't listen and respect the guidance you were given?
dialogue.en: Do you see what happens when you don't listen and respect the guidance you were given?

dialogue.text: Looks like these plants needed care and attention, so do your minds.
dialogue.zh: 這些植物需要關心和照顧，你們的心靈也是如此。
dialogue.ja: この植物が世話と注意を必要とするように、あなたたちの心も同じです。
dialogue.local: Looks like these plants needed care and attention, so do your minds.
dialogue.en: Looks like these plants needed care and attention, so do your minds.

dialogue.text: By ignoring lessons and mocking others, you stop your own growth.
dialogue.zh: 忽視課程和嘲笑他人，就是阻止自己的成長。
dialogue.ja: 授業を無視し他人を嘲笑うことで、自分の成長を止めてしまうのです。
dialogue.local: By ignoring lessons and mocking others, you stop your own growth.
dialogue.en: By ignoring lessons and mocking others, you stop your own growth.

dialogue.text: Max and Clara lowered their heads, realizing their mistake.
dialogue.zh: 麥克斯和克拉拉低下頭，意識到自己的錯誤。
dialogue.ja: マックスとクララは頭を下げ、自分の過ちに気づきました。
dialogue.local: Max and Clara lowered their heads, realizing their mistake.
dialogue.en: Max and Clara lowered their heads, realizing their mistake.

dialogue.text: They felt ashamed of how they had treated Mrs. Eliza and the example they had set for their classmates.
dialogue.zh: 他們為自己對待伊莉莎夫人和給同學們樹立的壞榜樣感到羞愧。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはエリザ先生への態度とクラスメートへの悪い見本を示したことを恥じました。
dialogue.local: They felt ashamed of how they had treated Mrs. Eliza and the example they had set for their classmates.
dialogue.en: They felt ashamed of how they had treated Mrs. Eliza and the example they had set for their classmates.

dialogue.text: That afternoon, Max and Clara stayed behind after class.
dialogue.zh: 那天下午，麥克斯和克拉拉課後留下來。
dialogue.ja: その日の午後、マックスとクララは授業後に残りました。
dialogue.local: That afternoon, Max and Clara stayed behind after class.
dialogue.en: That afternoon, Max and Clara stayed behind after class.

dialogue.text: They approached Mrs. Eliza, who was cleaning the blackboard.
dialogue.zh: 他們走向正在擦黑板的伊莉莎夫人。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは黒板を掃除しているエリザ先生に近づきました。
dialogue.local: They approached Mrs. Eliza, who was cleaning the blackboard.
dialogue.en: They approached Mrs. Eliza, who was cleaning the blackboard.

dialogue.text: For sorry, Mrs. Eliza, Max said his voice trembling.
dialogue.zh: 對不起，伊莉莎夫人，麥克斯顫抖著聲音說。
dialogue.ja: 「ごめんなさい、エリザ先生」とマックスは震える声で言いました。
dialogue.local: For sorry, Mrs. Eliza, Max said his voice trembling.
dialogue.en: For sorry, Mrs. Eliza, Max said his voice trembling.

dialogue.text: We've been so disrespectful and we didn't realize how much we were missing.
dialogue.zh: 我們太不尊重您了，卻沒意識到自己錯過了多少。
dialogue.ja: 「私たちはとても失礼でした。どれだけ大切なことを見逃していたか気づきませんでした」と言いました。
dialogue.local: We've been so disrespectful and we didn't realize how much we were missing.
dialogue.en: We've been so disrespectful and we didn't realize how much we were missing.

dialogue.text: Clara nodded, tears in her eyes.
dialogue.zh: 克拉拉點頭，眼中含淚。
dialogue.ja: クララは涙を浮かべながらうなずきました。
dialogue.local: Clara nodded, tears in her eyes.
dialogue.en: Clara nodded, tears in her eyes.

dialogue.text: We thought we knew everything, but we were wrong.
dialogue.zh: 我們以為自己什麼都知道，但我們錯了。
dialogue.ja: 「私たちは何でも知っていると思っていましたが、間違っていました」と言いました。
dialogue.local: We thought we knew everything, but we were wrong.
dialogue.en: We thought we knew everything, but we were wrong.

dialogue.text: Will you forgive us?
dialogue.zh: 您會原諒我們嗎？
dialogue.ja: 「許していただけますか？」
dialogue.local: Will you forgive us?
dialogue.en: Will you forgive us?

dialogue.text: Mrs. Eliza smiled warmly.
dialogue.zh: 伊莉莎夫人溫暖地微笑著。
dialogue.ja: エリザ先生は温かく微笑みました。
dialogue.local: Mrs. Eliza smiled warmly.
dialogue.en: Mrs. Eliza smiled warmly.

dialogue.text: Of course my dear children, learning from our mistakes is one of the most important lessons of all.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我親愛的孩子們，從錯誤中學習是最重要的課題之一。
dialogue.ja: 「もちろんよ、子どもたち。失敗から学ぶことは最も大切な教訓の一つです」と言いました。
dialogue.local: Of course my dear children, learning from our mistakes is one of the most important lessons of all.
dialogue.en: Of course my dear children, learning from our mistakes is one of the most important lessons of all.

dialogue.text: I'm proud of you for realizing it.
dialogue.zh: 我為你們能意識到這點感到驕傲。
dialogue.ja: 「それに気づいたあなたたちを誇りに思います」と言いました。
dialogue.local: I'm proud of you for realizing it.
dialogue.en: I'm proud of you for realizing it.

dialogue.text: From that day on, Max and Clara became model students.
dialogue.zh: 從那天起，麥克斯和克拉拉成為了模範學生。
dialogue.ja: その日から、マックスとクララは模範的な生徒になりました。
dialogue.local: From that day on, Max and Clara became model students.
dialogue.en: From that day on, Max and Clara became model students.

dialogue.text: They listened attentively, participated eagerly, and even helped their classmates.
dialogue.zh: 他們專心聆聽，積極參與，甚至幫助同學。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは熱心に聞き、積極的に参加し、クラスメートを助けるようになりました。
dialogue.local: They listened attentively, participated eagerly, and even helped their classmates.
dialogue.en: They listened attentively, participated eagerly, and even helped their classmates.

dialogue.text: The classroom slowly returned to its warm, joyful atmosphere.
dialogue.zh: 教室慢慢恢復了溫暖快樂的氛圍。
dialogue.ja: 教室は徐々に温かく楽しい雰囲気を取り戻しました。
dialogue.local: The classroom slowly returned to its warm, joyful atmosphere.
dialogue.en: The classroom slowly returned to its warm, joyful atmosphere.

dialogue.text: The other students, inspired by Max and Clara's transformation, also started showing more respect to Mrs. Eliza.
dialogue.zh: 其他學生受到麥克斯和克拉拉轉變的啟發，也開始更加尊重伊莉莎夫人。
dialogue.ja: マックスとクララの変化に触発された他の生徒たちも、エリザ先生に対してより敬意を示すようになりました。
dialogue.local: The other students, inspired by Max and Clara's transformation, also started showing more respect to Mrs. Eliza.
dialogue.en: The other students, inspired by Max and Clara's transformation, also started showing more respect to Mrs. Eliza.

dialogue.text: Years later, when Max and Clara had grown up and become successful in their careers, they often looked back on their time and Mrs. Eliza's class.
dialogue.zh: 多年後，當麥克斯和克拉拉長大並在事業上取得成功時，他們經常回想起那段時光和伊莉莎夫人的課堂。
dialogue.ja: 何年も経ち、マックスとクララが大人になり成功したとき、彼らはよくあの時代とエリザ先生の授業を振り返りました。
dialogue.local: Years later, when Max and Clara had grown up and become successful in their careers, they often looked back on their time and Mrs. Eliza's class.
dialogue.en: Years later, when Max and Clara had grown up and become successful in their careers, they often looked back on their time and Mrs. Eliza's class.

dialogue.text: They realized that the seeds they had planted that day were more than just plants.
dialogue.zh: 他們意識到，那天種下的種子不僅僅是植物。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは、その日に植えた種がただの植物以上のものだと気づきました。
dialogue.local: They realized that the seeds they had planted that day were more than just plants.
dialogue.en: They realized that the seeds they had planted that day were more than just plants.

dialogue.text: They were lessons about respect, humility, and the value of learning.
dialogue.zh: 那是關於尊重、謙遜和學習價值的課程。
dialogue.ja: それは尊敬、謙虚さ、そして学ぶことの価値についての教訓でした。
dialogue.local: They were lessons about respect, humility, and the value of learning.
dialogue.en: They were lessons about respect, humility, and the value of learning.

dialogue.text: And so, the students of Brightwood Academy carried Mrs. Eliza's wisdom with them.
dialogue.zh: 因此，布萊特伍德學院的學生們帶著伊莉莎夫人的智慧前行。
dialogue.ja: こうして、ブライトウッドアカデミーの生徒たちはエリザ先生の知恵を胸に抱きました。
dialogue.local: And so, the students of Brightwood Academy carried Mrs. Eliza's wisdom with them.
dialogue.en: And so, the students of Brightwood Academy carried Mrs. Eliza's wisdom with them.

dialogue.text: Teaching others that respect for teachers is the foundation of true growth and success.
dialogue.zh: 教導他人尊重老師是成長與成功的基礎。
dialogue.ja: 教師への敬意が真の成長と成功の基盤であることを他の人に教えました。
dialogue.local: Teaching others that respect for teachers is the foundation of true growth and success.
dialogue.en: Teaching others that respect for teachers is the foundation of true growth and success.
